description: This file declares the WorkerThread class and its factory, which manage a worker thread for processing player tasks asynchronously. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and private members related to task handling, synchronization, and thread management.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Implements a worker thread that processes player tasks asynchronously, managing task queue, thread lifecycle, and synchronization.

classes.name: WorkerThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of WorkerThread.

methods.name: WorkerThread
methods.description: Constructor for WorkerThread, initializes the thread object.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Waits for the worker thread to finish execution.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a new player task to the queue for processing.

methods.name: taskHandler
methods.description: Private method that runs in the thread to process tasks.

methods.name: waitForTask
methods.description: Retrieves the next task from the queue, waiting if necessary.
